posts.t: It’s crazy how 85 percent or so of Cole Caufield’s goals you can see coming from a mile away.
Shot stopped on a 4 on 2, Suzuki grabs the pick and feeds Caufield in front 3-1 MTL ##GoHabsGo
Cole Caufield scores to put the Canadiens up 2-1. The puck was sitting behind the net and Slafkovsky poked it away from Zellweger right to Caufield, who ripped it by Luukkonen.
